explanation: Feature 318 amendments 2-3, option A as the GM chose it for how it shapes the map: every two homesteads a lane's room apart (20 ft), each seat asks only whether its yard opens onto lane ground (SeatRegion.opens, a raster flood kept current as houses stand), and once the last house stands each household's way is laid in the gaps (gap_ways.lay_the_ways: one Dijkstra flood plus a local search per house) and every household's way is drawn and kept by the web. The growth is in homesteads (+0.3 to +0.8 s a map: the lane raster and the gap pass), web (+0.1 to +0.4 s: every household's way drawn, settled and kept), and on 20/40-hh seed 47/39 the notice stage (+0.7/+2.1 s: the board sought on a looser cluster). The tie-break (field nearness only among seats in the same 20 ft ring) is the speedup the GM asked for and holds 40 households at -5.7%. The prototype measured the split on 9 nucleated seeds: homesteads sums main 9.85 s, tie-break only 9.96 s, option A 14.38 s, so the increase is option A, accepted by the GM 2026-10-03: Yes, I still want A for how it shapes the map.
